column1: # scripts/ci/check-output-contract.py reads it: --static in Guard's unit-tests job (tests/test_output_contract.py)
# checks every row against the code, and the e2e case output-contract-1-hg002 checks the files the
#   kind       file, param (a nextflow_schema.json param), tool (a --tools name in main.nf) or
#              switch (a run-all.sh switch, its SWITCHES list)
#   name       file: its path under the results folder (GENOME_DIR for the bash steps and run-all.sh,
#              --outdir for nextflow run), {sample} for the sample id, {family} for --family_name;
#              * where the name varies. Other kinds: the name as typed.
#   step       the step number (assets/steps.tsv), - for none
#   process    the Nextflow process that publishes the file, - when no module does (a bash step,
#   legs       file: who writes it under this name: nextflow (main.nf and run-all.sh), bash (the
#              single step script), both. Other kinds: -
#   format     file: tsv, csv, vcf, json, text, html, bam, cram, index, bed, dir, zip, svg, png, md,
#   stability  stable: kept until 2.0; experimental: an opt-in engine new in 1.0, listed but free to
#              change in a 1.x release; internal: a task file that is not published, listed so the
#   e2e        the leg (bash, nextflow, both) whose HG002 e2e run must write the file, - for none
#   required   tsv and csv: the columns; vcf: the INFO/ and FORMAT/ fields of its header; json: the
#              top-level keys; comma-separated, - for none. More columns may come; none of these may go.
